Clicked 消息. Event dispatch confirmed. Nothing on the page changed in a way attributable to this click. Likely causes: the element is only a container and the real control is inside or beside it; the effect is asynchronous; or the page ignored this input. Do not blindly click the same target again — observe the page first.
